$comment: Line-coverage floors for the host scripts under the bats unit tests (tests/unit), measured with kcov in a Fedora container by .github/workflows/coverage-gate.yml and enforced by scripts/coverage-gate.mjs. kcov measures only lines for Bash. The tests run each script from a scratch copy of the repo at one fixed path (APPBOX_TEST_REPO), so 'file' is matched as a path suffix in kcov's per-file list. Each floor sits a few points below the 'measured' number from the CI run named there; scripts/coverage-gate.mjs reads only 'floor'. kcov never credits an empty case arm or a 'done < file' line, so host/appbox-update cannot reach 100%. Floors only go up. Raising a floor makes the check catch more, so it is the 'Adding or widening a check' case in AGENTS.md's owner's standing decisions: an agent may raise one without asking. Lowering a floor, or exempting anything from it, needs the owner.
